notConfigured: No sending address is set: nothing is sent. Paste it in the “Settings” tab.
configured: Sending address set. New content is announced automatically, with one check per minute.
errTest: Sending failed: {error}. Check the sending address in the “Settings” tab.
errNoWebhook: No valid sending address is set.
ytOn: Your YouTube lives are announced too (checked every {minutes} minutes at most, one message per live).
ytOff: Your YouTube lives are not announced. To do so, tick “Announce my YouTube lives too” in the settings.
